name: PinBee
summary: Browser extension that shows saves, reactions, shares and a viral score on every Pinterest pin, with keyword, rank and account research in the paid plan.
best_for: Pinterest bloggers, Etsy and Shopify sellers and social media managers who want to see which pins perform before they create their own
skip_if: you need a mobile app, you want to be sure of the final price before you read the checkout, or you only post occasionally and the free stats already answer your question
honest_knock: The pricing page disagrees with itself: the plan cards say $9, $49 and $99 while the FAQ still quotes $5, $29 and $49. It works on desktop browsers only, and the free plan scans four pages per search.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, $49 a year (3-day trial) or $99 once
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-10 on pinbee.net) PinBee has a free plan with no time limit and no account, and PinBee Pro on three plans: $9 a month, $49 a year (the page says that is $4.08 a month) or $99 once for a lifetime licence. The yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial and the page says you are not charged if you cancel before it ends; monthly and lifetime have no trial. A 14-day money-back guarantee covers every plan. One licence key works on up to 3 browsers. Payment runs through Lemon Squeezy, which handles billing and sales tax, and the checkout store lists the range as $9.00 to $99.00. The FAQ on the same page still quotes older figures ($5 monthly, $29 yearly, $49 lifetime), which disagree with the plan cards, so we use the cards and the checkout; check the amount at checkout before you pay. Prices are in US dollars; we did not open checkout, so the tax added is not known.

free_plan_evidence: (read 2026-11-10 on pinbee.net) PinBee has a free plan with no time limit and no account, and PinBee Pro on three plans: $9 a month, $49 a year (the page says that is $4.08 a month) or $99 once for a lifetime licence.
